Name: Profile for Imagery Access Person Identification Version B
Description: The Profile for Imagery Access Person Identification Version B (PIAPEB) TRE is designed to identify information contained in the Imagery Archive that is directly related to a person(s) contained in a data type (image, symbol, label, and text). This extension shall be present for each person identified in a data type, and there may be up to 500 occurrences of this extension for each data type in an NITF file.

LASTNME.Name: Last Name
LASTNME.Description: This field identifies the surname of the individual in the captured image.

FIRSTNME.Name: First Name
FIRSTNME.Description: This field identifies the first name of the individual in the captured image.

MIDNME.Name: Middle Name
MIDNME.Description: This field identifies the middle name of the individual in the captured image.

DOB.Name: Birth Date
DOB.Description: This field identifies the birth date of the individual in the captured image.

ASSOCTRY.Name: Associated Country
ASSOCTRY.Description: This field identifies the country the person in the capture image is/are associated with. The value of this field is per FIPS 10-4.
